asks: What time do you make it?
Do you want to stand in this? Most people want to stand in this.
Have you seen where I am pointing, or shall I move?
description: A solid column of afternoon light comes down through the ceiling at a slant, thick with turning dust, and lands on one small patch of the floor as though it had been aiming.
emotes: {it} swings a few degrees and lands on something else, which is immediately the most important thing in the room.
The dust turning inside {it} slows, stops, and starts going the other way.
{it} narrows to a stripe and widens again, and the room gets briefly enormous.
looks: The dust in it turns slowly, all in the same direction, and the direction is not the one the air is going.
It is warm on the back of your hand. It is warm the way a wall is warm at four in the afternoon.
It moves onto the right thing and settles, and it is right.
name: a shaft of desert sun
says: There. That one. Look at that one.
I have been pointing at it all along.
It is later than it is in here.
